The tier is documented as inclusive at 50 — both the function docstring (line 28: '50+ -> 10%') and README.md ('50+ units 10%'). For quantity == 50 the `> 50` comparison is False, so execution falls through to the `quantity >= 10` branch on line 33 and returns 5 (the 5% tier). Quantities 51–99 still return 10 and 100+ returns 15, so only exactly 50 units is affected, matching the bug report and the failing parameterization test_bulk_discount_tiers[50-10]. The sole caller, LineItem.total in pyshop/cart.py:25, passes qty unchanged and applies the returned pct via apply_discount, so any cart line of exactly 50 units is under-discounted (overcharged) by 5 percentage points.
